scenarios.name: Retain a custom command in its expanded area across a ribbon tab switch

scenario_steps.name: the full Tools ribbon is visible
the Part Tools custom panel target is initially empty
2D Sketches has been added to the Part Tools custom panel
2D Sketches has been moved into the User Commands expanded area
the user opens the User Commands expanded area
the 2D Sketches icon is visible in that area
the user selects the 3D Model ribbon tab
the Tools expanded area is no longer visible
the user selects the Tools ribbon tab again
the User Commands panel is collapsed and offers an expansion control
the 2D Sketches icon is absent from its main area
the user opens the User Commands expanded area
the 2D Sketches icon is visible in that area
